description: Schema for deterministic per-file Lean4/clean frontend universe/level and typeclass-resolution artifacts consumed by generate_frontend_classification.py. The generator treats absent artifacts as missing evidence and present artifacts that violate this schema as stale_or_invalid evidence. Valid artifacts remain pending cross-check until compared against parse, elaboration, kernel, and level_typeclass_resolution classifications.

field_constraints.engine: must equal lean4 or clean and match the path engine segment
field_constraints.filename: must equal the corpus filename, including .lean
field_constraints.source_sha256: must equal the current sha256: digest from tests/lean4_compat/MANIFEST.json
field_constraints.command: must be a non-empty array of non-empty strings
field_constraints.level_typeclass_status: must be success when resolution_failures is 0 and failure otherwise
field_constraints.resolution_failures: must be a non-negative integer less than or equal to level_constraints_checked + typeclass_goals_checked
field_constraints.level_constraints: when present, must be an array of non-empty strings whose length equals level_constraints_checked
field_constraints.typeclass_goals: when present, must be an array of non-empty strings whose length equals typeclass_goals_checked
field_constraints.observed_process_status: when present, must be exited or timeout; timeout evidence cannot claim level_typeclass_status success
